content.json:
# AI FinOps — Foundry Agents
Token usage, model routing and health for the demo agents.

_This workbook does not assign one price to all deployments. The lab uses chat, embedding, optimization, and Model Router deployments with different rates. Reconcile model-specific usage with current Azure pricing and Azure Cost Management._
## Usage & chargeback inputs
**Usage by agent:** prompt and completion tokens plus call count. Apply the current rate for each actual request/response model outside this workbook.
**Token share by agent:** each agent's share of total measured tokens. Token share is not cost share when models or token classes have different rates.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize prompt=sum(inTok), completion=sum(outTok), calls=count() by agent | extend total_tokens=prompt+completion | order by total_tokens desc
content.title: Measured token usage by agent

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize total_tokens=sum(inTok)+sum(outTok) by agent | order by total_tokens desc
content.title: Token share by agent

content.json: **Tokens per successful request:** measured tokens divided by successful calls; combine this with the actual model-specific rate for a cost calculation.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize prompt=sum(inTok), completion=sum(outTok), total=count(), ok=countif(success==true) by agent | extend success_rate=round(100.0*ok/total,1), tokens_per_success=round(iff(ok>0,todouble(prompt+completion)/ok,real(null)),1) | project agent, total, ok, success_rate, prompt, completion, tokens_per_success | order by tokens_per_success desc
content.title: Tokens per successful request

content.json: **Daily token trend:** measured prompt and completion volume per day; use model-specific pricing for cost.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) | summarize prompt=sum(inTok), completion=sum(outTok), calls=count() by bin(timestamp, 1d) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Daily token usage trend

content.json: ## Token usage
**Tokens by agent:** measured prompt vs completion tokens. Their relative prices depend on the actual model and deployment type.
**Completion tokens per hour:** hourly volume per agent, revealing load patterns and busy periods.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize prompt=sum(inTok), completion=sum(outTok) by agent | order by completion desc
content.title: Tokens by agent (prompt vs completion)

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize completion=sum(outTok) by bin(timestamp, 1h), agent | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Completion tokens per hour by agent

content.json: ## Health & efficiency
**Latency percentiles:** p50, p95 and p99 per agent; the p95/p99 tail is what users actually feel.
**Truncated-response rate:** share cut off by the token cap (finish_reason = length); high means raise max_tokens or trim prompts.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize p50_ms=round(percentile(duration,50),0), p95_ms=round(percentile(duration,95),0), p99_ms=round(percentile(duration,99),0), calls=count() by agent | order by p95_ms desc
content.title: Latency percentiles by agent (ms)

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']), fr=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.response.finish_reasons']) | summarize total=count(), truncated=countif(fr has 'length') by agent | extend truncated_pct=round(100.0*truncated/total,1) | project agent, total, truncated, truncated_pct | order by truncated_pct desc
content.title: Truncated-response rate (finish_reason = length)

content.json: **Cached-input token ratio:** percent of measured input served from prompt cache. Apply the actual model's cached-input rate to calculate savings.
**Routed model distribution:** which model the router picked and its measured token volume. Price each routed model separately.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), cached=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cached_input_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize input=sum(inTok), cached=sum(coalesce(cached,0)) by agent | extend cached_pct=round(100.0*todouble(cached)/iff(input>0,input,1),1) | project agent, input, cached, cached_pct | order by cached_pct asc
content.title: Cached-input token ratio by agent

content.query: dependencies | where tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model'])=='model-router' | extend routed=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.response.model']), inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) | summarize calls=count(), input=sum(inTok), output=sum(outTok) by routed | as T | extend pct_calls=round(100.0*calls/toscalar(T|summarize sum(calls)),1) | project routed, calls, pct_calls, input, output | order by calls desc
content.title: Model router - routed model distribution

content.json: **Tool error rate:** calls and failure rate per tool; stays empty until tool-using agents run.

content.query: dependencies | where tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name'])=='execute_tool' or isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.tool.name'])) | extend tool=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.tool.name']) | summarize calls=count(), failures=countif(success==false), avg_ms=round(avg(duration),0) by tool | extend error_rate_pct=round(100.0*failures/calls,1) | project tool, calls, failures, error_rate_pct, avg_ms | order by error_rate_pct desc, calls desc
content.title: Tool error rate (empty until tool-using agents run)

content.json:
## Illustrative Provisioned Throughput (PTU) comparison
This calculation starts with **illustrative assumptions**, not current Azure prices: 15 PTU, USD 1.00 per PTU-hour, USD 0.25 per one million input tokens, and USD 2.00 per one million output tokens. Replace all four values with current prices for **one comparable model and deployment type** before making a decision. Do not use a blended rate for Model Router or across this lab's chat and embedding deployments.

Rates, PTU minimums, reservations, regions, and customer agreements vary; reconcile the result with Azure pricing and Cost Management. Short sampling windows extrapolate aggressively.
**PTU vs consumption:** populated using the illustrative assumptions above. Replace them with current, model-specific values before using the result for planning.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) | summarize prompt=sum(inTok), completion=sum(outTok), firstT=min(timestamp), lastT=max(timestamp) | extend windowHours=max_of(todouble(datetime_diff('second',lastT,firstT))/3600.0,1.0), total_tokens=prompt+completion, input_rate=toreal({InputPerMillionUSD}), output_rate=toreal({OutputPerMillionUSD}), ptu_count=toreal({PTU_Count}), ptu_rate=toreal({PTU_HourlyUSD}) | extend consumption_usd=prompt/1000000.0*input_rate+completion/1000000.0*output_rate, ptu_usd_day=ptu_count*ptu_rate*24 | extend tokens_per_day=round(total_tokens/windowHours*24,0), consumption_usd_day=round(consumption_usd/windowHours*24,2), configured=input_rate>0 and output_rate>0 and ptu_count>0 and ptu_rate>0 | extend price_per_token=consumption_usd/iff(total_tokens>0,total_tokens,1) | extend breakeven_tokens_day=iff(configured,round(ptu_usd_day/iff(price_per_token>0,price_per_token,1.0),0),real(null)), verdict=iff(not(configured),'Set current model-specific rates before comparing',iff(consumption_usd_day>=ptu_usd_day,'PTU cheaper at current volume','Consumption cheaper at current volume')) | project tokens_per_day, breakeven_tokens_day, consumption_usd_day=iff(configured,consumption_usd_day,real(null)), ptu_usd_day=iff(configured,round(ptu_usd_day,2),real(null)), verdict
content.title: PTU vs consumption break-even

content.json:
## Semantic cache (AI gateway)
APIM LLM **semantic caching** on the citadel gateway serves repeated/rephrased prompts from Redis instead of re-billing the model. Each **hit** is one model call — and its tokens — avoided. Metrics come from the `emit-metric` in the cache policy (namespace `semantic-cache`), landing in the gateway's Application Insights.

_Empty until the `cache-demo` API receives traffic (run `demo/semantic-caching/demo-semantic-cache.ps1`)._
**Cache hit-rate and calls avoided:** hits, misses and hit-rate; every hit is one model call (and its tokens) saved.
**Cache hit-rate over time:** hourly hit-rate; it climbs as the cache warms up with repeated questions.

content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'SemanticCache' | extend result = tostring(customDimensions.result) | summarize cache_hits = sumif(valueCount, result == 'hit'), cache_misses = sumif(valueCount, result == 'miss'), total_requests = sum(valueCount) | extend hit_rate_pct = round(100.0 * cache_hits / total_requests, 1), model_calls_avoided = cache_hits | project total_requests, cache_hits, cache_misses, hit_rate_pct, model_calls_avoided
content.title: Cache hit-rate & model calls avoided

content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'SemanticCache' | extend result = tostring(customDimensions.result) | summarize hits = sumif(valueCount, result == 'hit'), total = sum(valueCount) by bin(timestamp, 1h) | extend hit_rate_pct = round(100.0 * hits / total, 1) | project timestamp, hit_rate_pct | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Cache hit-rate over time (%)

content.json: **Hits vs misses:** proportion of gateway requests served from cache versus forwarded to the model.

content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'SemanticCache' | extend result = tostring(customDimensions.result) | summarize requests = sum(valueCount) by result | order by requests desc
content.title: Hits vs misses
